title: The Clockwork Cellar
setting: A made-up valley, and under its mill a cellar of gears. Every name here is a character, never a player.

beats.prompt: Pell takes the rotten stair first.

outcomes.strong: Every step holds, and Pell calls the others down.
outcomes.weak: A step gives; Pell hangs on, and the others hear it.
outcomes.miss: The stair goes; everyone arrives at once, in a heap.

beats.prompt: Juno reads which gears still turn.

outcomes.strong: One gear in the wall turns backwards. That is the way in.
outcomes.weak: Juno finds the way in, and trips a bell finding it.

scenes.title: The gear cellar
opening: Prince Aldric hangs in a cage of springs.
Under Cogwen's hand is one red button.

beats.prompt: Does anyone press the red button?

proposes.fact: The red button is bait: whoever leaves it alone wins the room.

beats.prompt: Brann says a friend has come down after them.

proposes.fact: A guest walks into the cellar: the Lantern Man, who carries his own light and answers only in riddles.

outcomes.strong: Cogwen laughs, a sound like a dropped spanner, and opens the cage.
outcomes.weak: Cogwen opens the cage, and keeps one spring.
outcomes.miss: The cage holds, and Cogwen asks another riddle.

proposes.fact: Prince Aldric is free, and owes Brann's goats a favour.

beats.prompt: Juno tries the riddle another way, upside down.

outcomes.strong: Cogwen has never heard it asked upside down. The cage opens.
outcomes.weak: The cage opens a crack, enough for a prince who breathes in.
outcomes.miss: Cogwen winds the cage tighter, and the night ends with the prince still in it.

beats.prompt: Is the prince free, the second time?

proposes.fact: Prince Aldric is free, and owes Juno a riddle.
